svg.text: Toxiproxy latency on the Raft consensus port: replication must still converge

g.text: create the Raft and HTTP proxies
create the Raft and HTTP proxies
500ms UP and DOWN on node 0 only,
the leader's count is measured and
the peer must merely match it
Every node is reached through Toxiproxy, and the Raft server list points at the proxy rather than at the containers.
All containers start in parallel; Testcontainers waits for each node's HTTP health probe.
Every node's cluster endpoint is polled once a second until one of them claims leadership.
GET /api/v1/cluster -> body contains "isLeader":true (the run fails after 60s)
Database and schema are written through the leader, which Raft carries to every follower.
CREATE VERTEX TYPE User, Photo - EDGE TYPE HasUploaded, FriendOf, Likes - UNIQUE_HASH / FULL_TEXT / GEOSPATIAL
A clean baseline first: replication is verified before any toxic exists.
The delay hits the consensus port only: the HTTP command path stays fast, the Raft round trip pays.
The write duration is logged rather than asserted; what must hold is that all three nodes still reach 30 users.
The toxics are removed and the final counts are asserted on a healthy network.
Three siblings vary where the delay sits and how extreme it gets.
